title: 1994 FZJ80 5.3l and 4L60e swap
transmission: 2WD 4L60E with Mark's adapter and spud shaft
ai_summary: 1994 FZJ80 swap using a low-mileage 2006 Vortec L33 5.3L all-aluminum LS-derived V8 (factory rated 310hp/335 lb-ft) paired to a 2WD 4L60E automatic via a Mark's adapter and spud shaft, retaining the stock full-time transfer case. After PCM tuning the builder estimated output closer to 350hp/350 lb-ft. An F-body oil pan and LS3 exhaust manifolds were fitted along with a custom harness and fuse block.

complications.detail: Aluminum LS block runs hot; required a custom-mounted dual electric fan setup (sourced from a mid-1990s Lincoln Continental) sized to fully cover the stock radiator
Custom wiring harness and fuse block fabricated; MAF sensor intake tube damage discovered during diagnostics
Original Toyota A/C compressor is incompatible with the GM engine mounting; required custom hose fabrication to mate a Denso GM compressor to the existing evaporator/condenser
